messages.text: This pic of my dog came out blurry when I took it on my phone. I was a little disappointed because I really like this photo. Could you make it clearer and bigger, with 640 pixels on the long side? I’m fond of this dog, so even an ordinary photo like this means a lot to me. Please keep it looking natural.

style.prompt: Restore this exact photo: remove the blur and make it sharp and clear, with natural fine fur detail. Keep everything else the same: the same golden retriever, same pose, face, expression, tongue, colors, lighting, grass and trees background, and same framing. Natural photographic look, no added objects, no stylization, no over-sharpening.
